risk_note: RV2 (linking/**; user authorization paths: the pdd filing query and the Taobao credential exchange). The pdd authority query (open and GET bindings) shares one in-process cap of 8: full -> no adapter call, treated as a failed query (open 50303 with nothing written; GET 200 with the stored projection); a slot is freed exactly once when an admitted query ends (success, throw, malformed). The bind submission runs through one process-wide admission queue (4 running, 16 waiting, 2 s wait, FIFO, handoff on throw): full or timed out -> 42901 + Retry-After before the idempotent transaction and before the state is consumed (state not burnt, exchange not called, no idempotency record). Queued work runs in its own request's async context. Union governance (timeouts, retries, breaker, quota) unchanged; no new codes or configuration.
